headline.title: Saigon Nail Studio, 0.8 km away, has 148 Google reviews. T’s Nails & Beauty has 101.
headline.detail: Your rating is 4.9, as high or higher than theirs. The quality is there; the volume isn't yet. On a map, people comparing nail salons often pick the bigger number.

summary: T’s Nails & Beauty has 101 Google reviews at 4.9, and reviews praise BIAB that lasts five weeks and meticulous technicians. We compared you with the 4 nearest independent nail salons, and the gap is not quality but how easily new clients can find, trust and book you.
visibility: We compared T’s Nails & Beauty with the 4 nearest independent nail salons on Google Maps (ratings, review counts and opening hours as shown today).
lead: 101 Google reviews at 4.9: more than 2 of the 4 nail salons nearby we compared.
Reviews praise BIAB that lasts five weeks and meticulous technicians.
Open until 8pm on weekdays, as late as or later than everyone nearby we compared.
Open on Sundays, when some nearby nail salons are closed.
lose: 2 of the 4 nail salons nearby have more reviews, up to 148 (Saigon Nail Studio).
New clients who don't know you yet compare nail salons on a phone in seconds; without your own booking-ready page, your best reviews stay buried in the listing.

gaps.title: The comparison happens before anyone calls
gaps.detail: People choosing a salon look at the map, the review count and a website, then book wherever it's easiest. Being the best isn't enough if it isn't visible.

gaps.title: Your strongest story is hidden
gaps.detail: Reviews praise BIAB that lasts five weeks and meticulous technicians. But someone new only sees a star rating, not why people love you.

gaps.title: Every appointment without a follow-up is a missed review
gaps.detail: Happy clients rarely leave a review unless someone asks at the right moment. That's how bigger nail salons pull ahead.

actions.title: Get a page that turns visitors into bookings
actions.why: Your reviews, treatments, hours and one-tap booking or WhatsApp on one fast page for phones.

actions.title: Ask every client for a review automatically
actions.why: A short message after each appointment; the quickest way to close the gap with nail salons that have more reviews.

actions.title: Reply to every new review this week
actions.why: Doable today, without us: it shows new visitors a real person who cares, and they notice.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your treatments, team and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking or WhatsApp from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each appointment, so happy clients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Offers and win-back messages
plan.detail: Intro offers for new clients and gentle reminders for those who haven't booked in a while.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against the nail salons nearby, and what to do next.

scenario: Someone new to Surry Hills wants to book a appointment this week. On Sunday evening they open Maps, see a few nail salons and tap the one with the most reviews and an easy booking page. T’s Nails & Beauty, with 101 reviews at 4.9, is close by, but they never get past the listing. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your regular clients keep coming back. New clients keep choosing whichever salon looks easiest to book on their phone.
